notes:
Stage: evaluating Hosted API first (fast path) with plan to benchmark Dedicated if POC meets SLOs.

Key contact(s): Liam O'Connor (Head of Product), Maya Patel (Platform Eng lead), Jordan Price (CTO).

Use-case summary:
- Primary: customer support chat agents integrated in product UI (web + mobile).
- Features required: streaming responses, tool/function calling (ticket lookup, CRM writebacks), structured outputs for UI cards, conversation history KV cache.
- Expected workload: 40-120 concurrent live agents during peak; avg 3.5 turns/session; 1.2M tokens/mo estimate for initial 50k MAU pilot.
- Latency SLO: first-token <= 1.5s across US region (p50 target 0.8-1.2s). "Showstopper" if cannot hit 1.5s - quote from Liam: "If we can't hit 1.5s first token it's a showstopper."

Model & routing preferences:
- Prefer low-latency, cost-balanced variants (13B Q4-style or optimized 7B for latency-critical paths).
- Want automatic fallback to smaller model for tail cases to preserve SLO and maintain UX.
- Will test Redwood-verified models + a custom finetuned variant later.
- Care about cold-start/kv warm-up behavior for short sessions.

POC ask / success criteria:
- 2-week Hosted API POC focused on streaming + tool-calling (ticket lookups + update flow).
- Metrics to validate: p50 first-token <1.2s, p95 <1.5s for peak profile; end-to-end tool call roundtrip <300ms; error rate <1% for tool calls; cost estimate for 1M tokens and extrapolated Dedicated cost with reserved capacity.
- Deliverable: latency/cost dashboard, suggestion for batching & caching config, routing policy for Dedicated rollout.

Security / compliance:
- Needs SOC2 evidence and SSO/SAML integration.
- Legal pushing on data residency options for EU customers (may require Dedicated or Private later).
- Requested KMS integration / audit logs for ticket writebacks.

Commercials & timeline:
- Mid-market procurement: internal finance approval once POC shows latency & cost delta for Dedicated.
- Estimated ARR (if successful): $75k-250k ARR first year.
- Timeline: kickoff POC Mar 17, 2-week execution, business review Apr 1, pricing decision by May.

Meetings / recent activity:
- 2026-03-11: Intro demo (AE Ava Chen) — covered streaming, function calling, example integrations.
- 2026-03-13: SE deep-dive with Diego Martinez — latency profiling, concurrency expectations.
- 2026-03-14: Legal shared security questionnaire (drive link above).

Open questions for Redwood:
- Provide a hosted latency profile for US east (p50/p95) for streaming responses at 50/100 concurrent sessions.
- Sample config for prefix caching & KV reuse for short-lived sessions.
- Pricing sheet that contrasts Hosted burst pricing vs Dedicated committed throughput (GPU pool uplift).
- Clarify fallback policy behavior across model variants (cost/latency tradeoffs).

Notes: Team is pragmatic, engineering-led procurement. Wants reproducible perf numbers from Hosted before moving to Dedicated. SE wants access to Firehose logs during POC for tracing.
